kestrel.name: Kestrel Manufacturing Inc. (fictional)
kestrel.note: Align each cohort to its Atlas wave: train in the 7 days before the wave's cutover (baseline plan W0-W7).

harborline.name: Harborline Logistics (fictional)
harborline.note: No training between 2026-11-15 and 2027-01-08 (peak season freeze); Gemini module only for the 100 pilot seats in phase 1.

M-EU-101.q: In Gmail, what replaces Outlook folders?
options: Labels — one email can have several
M-EU-101.why: Labels work like folders, but a message can carry more than one.

M-EU-101.q: What does Archive do to an email?
options: Removes it from the inbox but keeps it in All Mail
Moves it to a PST file
M-EU-101.why: Archived mail stays searchable in All Mail.

M-EU-101.q: How do you let an assistant manage your mailbox?
options: Add them as a delegate in Gmail settings
M-EU-101.why: Delegation gives access without sharing credentials.

M-EU-101.q: Where do you check colleagues' availability when booking a meeting?
M-EU-101.why: Find a time overlays attendees' free/busy.

M-EU-101.q: After cutover, what happens to mail sent to your usual address?
options: It arrives in Gmail — your address does not change
It waits until IT releases it
M-EU-101.why: MX records point to Google after cutover; the address is the same.

M-EU-101.q: You deleted an important email by mistake yesterday. Where is it?
M-EU-101.why: Gmail keeps deleted messages in Trash for 30 days.

M-EU-102.q: Who owns files stored in a Shared drive?
options: The team / organisation — files stay when someone leaves
M-EU-102.why: Shared drive content belongs to the team, not individuals.

M-EU-102.q: What is the safest way to share a file with a supplier?
options: Email it as an attachment to your personal account
Share with the supplier's named address and the least access needed
Upload it to a public website
M-EU-102.why: Named access with least privilege is traceable and revocable.

M-EU-102.q: Your department's file share has moved to...
options: A Shared drive with department membership
M-EU-102.why: Departmental shares map to Shared drives.

M-EU-102.q: Where do your migrated OneDrive files appear?
M-EU-102.why: OneDrive content migrates to the user's My Drive.

M-EU-102.q: You need to edit an Excel workbook with colleagues at the same time. Best option?
options: Open it in Sheets (or edit in Office-compatible mode) from Drive

M-GEM-110.q: Which prompt structure gives the best results?
options: As long as possible with no structure
M-GEM-110.why: Context, task and format make the output specific and usable.

M-GEM-110.q: Gemini drafted a customer email for you. Before sending you should...
options: Check facts, numbers and tone — you are accountable for it
Ask Gemini if it is correct
M-GEM-110.why: Generated content must be reviewed by its owner.

M-GEM-110.q: Can Gemini in Workspace show you content from files you cannot open?
options: No — it respects your existing access permissions
M-GEM-110.why: Gemini works within the user's existing permissions.

M-GEM-110.q: Under Google Workspace's commitments, is your organisation's content used to train models outside your organisation without permission?
M-GEM-110.why: Workspace commits that customer data is not used to train models outside the organisation without permission.

M-GEM-110.q: Where can you use 'Help me write'?
M-GEM-110.why: Help me write is available in Gmail and Docs.

M-ADM-301.q: What mainly determines which settings apply to a user?
M-ADM-301.why: Most settings are applied by OU, some by configuration groups.
2SV is enforced centrally in Security settings.

M-ADM-301.q: How do you replace a shared mailbox like orders@?
options: Create a user and share the password
A Google Group used as a collaborative inbox (or a delegated account when send-as is needed)
M-ADM-301.why: Groups with collaborative inbox avoid shared credentials.

M-ADM-301.q: The help desk needs to reset passwords. Which access should they get?
options: A least-privilege role such as Help Desk Admin
No admin role, just the password list
M-ADM-301.why: Least privilege: use a prebuilt or custom limited admin role.

M-ADM-301.q: A user says an external email never arrived. Where do you look first?
options: Email Log Search in the Admin console
M-ADM-301.why: Email Log Search traces delivery of individual messages.

M-FL-090.q: How do you add your work account on your phone? / ¿Cómo agrega su cuenta de trabajo en el teléfono?
M-FL-090.why: Add the Google account in the Gmail app; IT never asks for your password.

M-FL-090.q: Where do shift announcements arrive now? / ¿Dónde llegan ahora los avisos de turno?
M-FL-090.why: Each plant has a Chat space for announcements.

M-FL-090.q: You forgot your password. What do you do? / Olvidó su contraseña, ¿qué hace?
options: Call the help desk on ext. 4357 — never share passwords
M-FL-090.why: The help desk verifies identity and resets it.

M-FL-090.q: Can you open the safety procedures on your phone? / ¿Puede abrir los procedimientos de seguridad en el teléfono?
options: Yes, from the plant Shared drive in the Drive app
M-FL-090.why: Procedures live in the plant's Shared drive.

M-CH-210.q: On day one, what is a champion's first priority?
options: Help people sign in, find their mail and calendar, and log issues
M-CH-210.why: Day one is about sign-in and confidence; log what you cannot fix.

M-CH-210.q: A colleague cannot see a restricted Finance folder. You...
options: Log a ticket — never change permissions yourself
Ask them to use your laptop
M-CH-210.why: Access changes go through IT for audit.

options: The 'Workspace Move Help' Chat space / ticket form
M-CH-210.why: One channel keeps the hypercare queue complete.

M-CH-210.q: What is the champion coverage target?
M-CH-210.why: The playbook targets at least one champion per 50 users.

M-CH-210.q: How do we collect user sentiment after cutover?
M-CH-210.why: The T+3 pulse survey feeds adoption tactics.
